title: CUMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model value predictions on multiple-choice surveys (WorldValuesBench) by measuring the Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) between predicted probabilities and actual human value distributions, as well as computing pairwise win-rates for culturally resonant generations using an LLM judge (Community Alignment, PRISM datasets).

Conditioning model inputs on explicit, multi-faceted user profiles (including Age, Gender, Country, Education, Religion, Ethnicity, and Employment) to evaluate preference prediction accuracy and response validity across different demographic groups.
